draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
rationale: T1.r1.lat=41 (Corvex A2 fp16) and T1.r2.lat=118 (Corvex A1 fp32) support the numbers. The hedge "may" is appropriate given the cross-hardware comparison; the claim does not overstate. No statistical test reported, but the claim makes no significance assertion.
